```objc // Specify a media query. This one matches the entire library because it // doesn't contain a media property predicate. MPMediaQuery *everything = [[MPMediaQuery alloc] init]; // Configure the media query to group its media items; here, grouped by artist. [everything setGroupingType: MPMediaGroupingArtist]; // Obtain the media item collections from the query. NSArray *collections = [everything collections]; ```
